Use Tier 2 architectural deepening: add a learned first-order item-transition residual to SASRec, focusing on model_design and training_evaluation. This is one controlled architectural change, distinct from the previous MultVAE reconstruction-target experiment; keep MultVAE and equal-weight rank fusion unchanged. The measured 0.6225 macro HR@10 remains below the reported 0.6250 best, and Electronics at 0.455 suggests room for a complementary signal, although these results do not establish the plateau’s cause.

Add separate 32-dimensional source and destination item embeddings to SASRec, scoring each candidate with the existing transformer score plus the dot product between the current history item’s source embedding and the candidate’s destination embedding. Train this transition branch jointly using the existing positive and single-negative BCE supervision at every nonpadding sequence position, without changing sampling, optimizer settings, or reconstruction targets. Initialize source embeddings with small random values and destination embeddings to zero so initial scores match the original model while the new branch can learn. This provides a direct path for local item transitions that may be diluted by contextual attention, complementing MultVAE’s unordered preference representation.

Preserve all four datasets, supplied splits, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], existing checkpoint selection, and the SASREC_EPOCHS environment default of 200. Save the transition architecture configuration and weights, and update the predictor writer so validation and exported inference both call the same augmented SASRec scoring function, using the final history item and a zero transition contribution for empty histories. Compare against the supplied results using fixed validation candidates, 200 users per category, 99 unique eligible negatives, evaluation seed 42, and unweighted macro HR@10; verify checkpoint reload and exported-predictor agreement before printing the measured Final Validation Score. Keep execution on one GPU within the host-reported remaining search budget, store artifacts beneath the trial directory, and leave hidden-test access and final evaluation to the unchanged host.
